operations.new: If $\ell_j=b$, all query scores are zero and equal-weight hardmax returns the mean $\bar\ell=n^{-1}\sum_k\ell_k$. Thus, writing $\ell_{\max}=\max_k\ell_k$ and $\ell_{\min}=\min_k\ell_k$, the contribution $\psi(Z;b)-\psi(Z;b')$ for $b<b'$ is $\ell_{\max}-\ell_{\min}$ in the first coordinate when $b<\ell_j<b'$, $\bar\ell-\ell_{\min}$ when $\ell_j=b$, $\ell_{\max}-\bar\ell$ when $\ell_j=b'$, and zero when $\ell_j<b$ or $\ell_j>b'$. In particular, if no current code equals either threshold, it shifts exactly the columns strictly between them by $\ell_{\max}-\ell_{\min}$.
